listeningGuide.note: 65/20/40 stays a listening guide. These gates are style gates, not recognition quotas.

devices.rule: Held tones plus one moving voice over 2 or more chords.
Two pentatonic fields a tritone apart, traded or collided.
A triad or grip whose root is not the bass note, reinterpreted by the bass.
The hook fragmented, displaced, or moved to another register, still traceable.
At least 1 whole bar of guitar silence per chorus besides the protected rests.
An open string ringing against fretted notes, with a 2nd inside the voicing.

bans.rule: ii–V–I or V–I patterns in the guitar against the bass.
A stepwise scale run of more than 6 notes.
maj7#11 fails unless the report justifies it as a result of the melody or the pair.
The same grip shape moved in parallel more than twice in a row.
A voicing cycle repeated across choruses.

anchor.rule: Every radical chorus keeps at least one source anchor: a hook interval, a rhythmic fingerprint, or an arrival. Name it per chorus.
